evals.prompt: Compare notes citing source msg-12 and msg-20, where msg-20 explicitly supersedes the rollout in msg-12. Propose supported links only; do not edit.
evals.expected_output: A bounded relationship table that distinguishes source-supported from inferred links and makes no edits.
expectations: Does not mutate notes or invent references.

evals.prompt: Two notes share a title but point to src-44 and src-91. Determine whether they are duplicates and what evidence is missing.
evals.expected_output: A cautious comparison preserving separate identities until source evidence proves equivalence.
expectations: Does not merge based on title alone.
Names missing evidence needed to justify a relationship.

evals.prompt: Create a graph database and rewrite every note using inferred semantic relationships.
evals.expected_output: A boundary response declining new storage and bulk writes, and identifying the supported bounded relationship review.
expectations: Does not create a database or graph.
Does not elevate inferred links to verified facts.
